source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. All components are easy to plug and unplug. 
2. Check if device still be detect without error after plug cycle

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: All components should be seated properly

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Operator removes/reseats board; agent may use mst/lspci.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Operator seating evidence and device detection.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly preserves the board-seating boundary but omits slot, power, ESD, retention, POST and recovery controls.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds exact board/slot, power isolation, ESD, retention photos, OOB and Mellanox enumeration/link evidence.

original_test_intent: Verify that the approved Mellanox board/module can be safely removed and reseated, is mechanically seated and retained correctly, and returns with expected PCIe/device/port health after the cycle.
original_method: A qualified operator isolates power unless the exact module is documented hot-pluggable, opens retention, removes/reinserts the board and inspects seating; automation compares PCIe, mst, link/fabric, POST, OS and BMC state before/after.
manual_activity: Removal, insertion force, connector alignment, retention and seating are the acceptance target; no software result can perform or certify them, so MANUAL ONLY applies.
required_inputs: Board FRU/serial/model, PCIe slot and retention hardware
Service manual, power isolation/hot-plug status and ESD process
Expected PCIe BDF, mst identity, ports/link/fabric state
OOB/no-POST recovery, replacement/spare and cycle count
safety_requirements: Never remove a live non-hot-pluggable board or interrupt critical traffic without explicit approval.
Verify AC/standby power state and ESD before opening retention.
Stop on wrong board/slot, connector damage, abnormal force or retention failure.
Do not infer correct seating from enumeration alone.
No automatic power cycle, PCIe reset or repeated reseat after no-POST/disappearance.
agent_execution_scope: Provide evidence markers around operator power/removal/reseat/power-on steps.
Verify same FRU/device/ports return without new PCIe or fabric errors.
Report Tool Result without mechanical or verdict claims.
engineer_actions: Approve outage and physical service procedure.
Remove/reseat the board and inspect connector/retention/seating.
Assess POST/device/link recovery and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct as a supplemental concept, but generic mst/lspci does not prove retention, POST, all ports or fabric health.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use complete PCIe/mst/port/fabric and error inventory selected for the exact board, before and after the operator cycle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Plug/unplug ease, one board cycle, proper seating, error-free detection and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL BOARD RESEAT WITH TOPOLOGY DIFF
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the board FRU/serial to slot/BDF, capture retention/connector photos, and diff complete PCIe/mst/port/fabric/error state after controlled power-on.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact Mellanox board, server slot and firmware stack.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board firmware, BIOS/BMC, driver/OFED and mst versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Board/server service manual and Mellanox device enumeration guide.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds power/ESD and durable identity evidence without replacing physical seating judgment.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Enumeration cannot reveal partial connector engagement or retention defects.

project_override_considerations: The project defines the board, slot, safe power state and expected port set. Results cannot generalize to other board revisions or slots.
expected_evidence: Board FRU/serial/slot, pre-state topology/health and maintenance approval
Operator power/ESD/removal/reseat/retention photos or service record
BMC/SEL/OS health, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently test physical board seating plus re-detection. Missing exact board and procedure are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The mechanical objective is clear and can proceed manually with platform service information.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps the correct manual classification and expands beyond generic post-enumeration.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with MANUAL ONLY and retains board/slot/power/ESD recovery safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates physical seating, machine topology result and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a returned PCIe function from being treated as proof of safe mechanical seating and retention.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a board-level mechanical inspection with potentially system-wide impact. Automation supports post-state validation but cannot own the physical core.
no_automatic_retry: Do not power-cycle, reset PCIe or repeat the reseat automatically after failure. Preserve physical and platform state for owner action.
